name: Terminal / Retro
tagline: Phosphor on black. Every pixel earns its place.
description: A dark-first system that borrows from terminals and line printers. Monospace everywhere, a bitmap display face for big moments, box-drawing borders, and status tags in brackets. The light mode is a printout, not an inverted screen.
useCases: changelogs and docs for technical products

fonts.role: display headlines and big numbers only

do: Set all text in JetBrains Mono at 14px; use VT323 only for display text and large numbers
Draw containers with 1px solid borders and label them in the top border like a terminal window title
Show status with bracket tags such as [ok], [warn], [err], colored by meaning
Prefix interactive rows and prompts with a > or $ character
Use inverse video (accent background, accent-ink text) for the selected row and the primary action
dont: Do not add glow, bloom, or text-shadow to phosphor text
Do not use scanline overlays on content that must be read
Do not use proportional fonts anywhere
Do not invert the dark theme to make the light theme; light mode is printout paper

components.name: Button
components.notes: Bracketed labels like [ deploy ]. Primary is inverse video; secondary is bordered; ghost is text with a > prefix on hover.

components.name: Input
components.notes: A prompt line: $ prefix, no box, a block cursor drawn with a blinking span. Error prints an [err] line below.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Bordered native select with a v chevron character; label written as a key with a colon, for example "env:".

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Checkbox rendered as [x] and [ ] text. Switch rendered as on / off segments with inverse video on the active one.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Bracket tags: [ok] accent, [warn] amber, [err] danger, [idle] muted.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Terminal window: title in the top border, body text, footer status line.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Single status line: product name, path, links separated by pipes, clock on the right. Mobile uses a details menu.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Box with a double top border, title line, body, and [ confirm ] [ cancel ] actions.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Fixed-width columns, header underlined with box-drawing characters, inverse selected row, numbers right-aligned.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Worker grid: a large throughput number in VT323, a sparkline made of block characters, queue depth, and a log excerpt.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A comment-style message (# nothing queued) and a command to copy.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: One-line log entries with timestamps and status tags, stacked.
